description_en: Queries the audit logs of SQL statements that are executed in Data Management (DMS)
description_zh: 获取在DMS进行SQL操作的审计日志列表
name: ListSQLExecAuditLog

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

The start time supports fuzzy match. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh:
开始操作的时间。

开始时间可模糊输入，时间格式为YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

The end time supports fuzzy match. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss format. We recommend that you use the StartTime and EndTime parameters to specify a time range that does not exceed one day. The returned entries can be displayed by page to improve query efficiency
parameters.help_zh:
结束操作的时间。
结束时间可模糊输入，时间格式为YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss，建议您输入的开始时间和结束时间间隔不要超过一天，方便分页拉取，提升效率
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database or instance based on which you want to query SQL statements.

If the SQL statements to be queried are at the instance level, you can set this parameter to an instance name. If the SQL statements to be queried are at the database level, you can set this parameter to a database name
parameters.help_zh:
搜索名称。
此处的搜索名称可输入数据库名，如果是实例级别的SQL操作，则可输入实例名称
parameters.name: search_name

parameters.help_en: The nickname of the user who wrote the SQL statement
parameters.name: op_user_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SQL statement. Valid values:

SELECT: the SQL statement that is used to query data.
INSERT: the SQL statement that is used to insert data.
DELETE: the SQL statement that is used to delete data.
CREATE_TABLE: the SQL statement that is used to create tables.

To view more types of SQL statements, log on to the DMS console and click Security and Specifications. In the left-side navigation pane, click Operation Audit. Then, you can view all supported types of SQL statements from the SQL type drop-down list
parameters.help_zh:
SQL类型，常见SQL类型取值说明如下：
SELECT：查询
INSERT：插入
DELETE：删除
CREATE_TABLE：创建表

您可以在控制台页面上方操作审计->SQL类型中查看更多SQL类型取值
parameters.name: sql_type

parameters.help_en:
The execution status of the SQL statement. Valid values:

FAIL: The SQL statement fails to be executed.
NOEXE: The SQL statement has not been executed.
RUNNING: The SQL statement is being executed.
CANCEL: The execution of the SQL statement is canceled.
SUCCESS: The SQL statement is executed
parameters.help_zh:
执行状态，取值说明如下：
-1：执行失败
0：暂未执行
2：执行中
-2：取消执行
1：执行成功
parameters.name: exec_state

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The value cannot exceed 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页数据量。最大值不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 开始页码。请输入合理的页码，若页码填写超过日志总页数，可能会操作总记录数不为0，但是操作审计日志列表信息为空的情况
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorMessage.example: StartTime is mandatory for this action.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
